During the development of the GMP-compliant formulation, we tested different GMP substitutes for the research-grade chemicals/reagents that are used in the lab-based culture medium [19]. This was done to ensure that the formulation meets the GMP standard. The corresponding reagents were comprehensively evaluated against the original research-grade components through rigorous cellular and molecular assays using at least three primary donor CSSC batches. After evaluating multiple GMP-grade reagents, we meticulously developed an optimized formulation that closely mirrors the research-grade culture medium. It is worth noting that human serum can be lipid- and protein-rich, depending on the donors. This can cause the culture medium to appear cloudy with the presence of insolubilities, although it is sterile. steps.title: Prepare EGF stock solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lyophilized EGF vial (500 mg) at 400 × g for 10–15 s, add 1 mL sterile distilled water to make 0.5 mg/mL, then dilute with DMEM/F12 containing 0.1 % Flexbumin to 10 mg/mL; aliquot 0.5 mL, store at –80 °C (or 2–8 °C for 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare PDGF‑BB stock solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lyophilized PDGF‑BB vial (50 mg) at 400 × g for 10–15 s, reconstitute with 4 mM HCl containing 0.1 % Flexbumin to 10 mg/mL, aliquot 0.5 mL, store at –80 °C (or 2–8 °C for 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare dexamethasone stock solution
steps.instruction: Wear PPE and eye protection, thaw Dex vial at RT 10–20 min, weigh ~50 mg, dissolve in distilled water to make a 10 mM stock (calculate volume from MW = 392.47 g·mol⁻¹), dilute with DMEM/F12 to 10 mM, aliquot 100 mL, store at –80 °C (or 2–8 °C for 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare collagenase working solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg collagenase NB6 powder in 10 mL sterile PBS (cGMP) to 10 mg/mL stock; aliquot 0.15 mL into sterile 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, store at –20 °C. Thaw aliquot 10–15 min at RT, add 1.35 mL DMEM/F12 with 0.1 % Flexbumin and 1× antibiotics/antimycotic to obtain 1 mg/mL working solution. Avoid repeat freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare fibronectin coating solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL injection water to 500 mg lyophilized fibronectin to make 500 mg/mL stock; aliquot to 50 mL, store at –80 °C (up to 1 yr) or 2–8 °C (1 wk). Dilute stock with sterile PBS to 10 mg/mL working solution, apply 1 mL per TCF25, coat at RT 15–30 min, then remove solution; surface ready for seeding.

steps.title: Prepare CryoStor CS5 cryopreservation medium
steps.instruction: Store CryoStor CS10 at 2–8 °C. Immediately before use, mix CS10 1:1 (v/v) with GMP culture medium to obtain CS5 (5 % DMSO). Use a controlled‑rate freezing container (e.g., Mr. Frosty) for cell freezing.

steps.title: Formulate GMP stem cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen reagents (EGF, PDGF‑BB, Dex) 10–15 min at RT (or overnight 2–8 °C), mix gently, brief spin. Combine 300 mL DMEM (1 g/L D‑glucose, GlutaMAX) with 200 mL Ham’s F12. Add 5 mL antibiotic‑antimycotic (1×), 2.5 mL insulin‑transferrin‑selenium (0.5×), 2.5 mL 2‑Phospho‑L‑Ascorbate (0.5 mM), 0.5 mL EGF (10 ng/mL), 0.5 mL PDGF‑BB (10 ng/mL), 0.5 mL dexamethasone (10 nM), 2 mL Flexbumin (0.1 % v/v), 10 mL human serum (2 % v/v). Filter‑sterilize, bring to RT before use.

steps.title: Select and receive donor corneas
steps.instruction: Obtain corneas from certified eye bank; donors <60 yr, no cancer/drug use, endothelial cell count >2,000 cells/mm², negative serology, death‑to‑recovery <12 h, preservation‑to‑arrival ≤5 days. Corneas are stored in Optisol GS (2–8 °C) without freezing, shipped in sterile moist chambers inside temperature‑controlled boxes (2–8 °C).

steps.title: Sterilize corneal tissue in antibiotic medium
steps.instruction: Inspect shipping container for cracks, wipe with 70 % ethanol. Transfer cornea to a TCD60 containing 6–8 mL DMEM/F12 with 1× antibiotics/antimycotic at RT; rinse twice, 10 min each.

steps.title: Remove anterior tissues and isolate limbal rim
steps.instruction: Under 0.8–2× stereomicroscopy, use toothed forceps, Vannas scissors, and a #10 surgical blade to remove conjunctiva/tenons, scrape anterior epithelium, and clear posterior iris, endothelium, and trabecular meshwork. Rinse in a second TCD100 with sterile PBS. Place cornea posterior side up, excise central 8 mm diameter with a trephine, leaving a peripheral rim (~0.5–1 mm width) with intact limbus.

steps.title: Trim limbal rim to anterior stromal blocks
steps.instruction: Cut the peripheral rim into quadrants with a #10 blade. At the outer limbus, make a vertical cut to remove sclera, leaving ~0.5 mm scleral tissue attached. Rinse quadrants in a third TCD100 PBS. Position strip vertically and trim to retain only the anterior 1/3–1/2 thickness. Rinse in a fourth TCD100 PBS, then cut the tissue into ~1 mm³ blocks.

steps.title: Digest tissue blocks with collagenase
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue blocks to a 2 mL tube containing 1 mg/mL collagenase NB6 working solution. Incubate 6–8 h at 37 °C with gentle rotation (30 rpm). During the final hour, triturate 5–10 times with a P1000 pipette tip, then continue incubation. After digestion, triturate the lysate with a P1000 or P200 tip, filter through a 70 μm cell strainer, wash the strainer with 10 mL PBS, collect filtrate into a 50 mL centrifuge tube, and centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min at RT.

steps.title: Obtain single‑cell suspension and seed P0
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 3 mL GMP SCCM at RT, transfer to a 15 mL tube, and centrifuge again 250 × g for 5 min at RT. Resuspend the final pellet in 5 mL GMP SCCM and seed onto fibronectin‑coated TCF25 (P0). Place flasks in a humidified 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Incubate primary culture and monitor clusters
steps.instruction: Observe cultures under phase‑contrast microscopy; clusters of 4–10 cells appear 3–7 days. Mark 2–3 early clusters. When marked clusters reach 50–70 % confluence, replace medium with fresh GMP SCCM. Change medium every 48–72 h. If no clusters appear after 14 days, discard culture.

steps.title: Sub‑passage P0 cells to P1 culture
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium, rinse flask with 5 mL PBS, add 1 mL TrypLE Select CTS, incubate ~1 min at 37 °C. Rock flask or pipette 5–10 times to detach cells, collect suspension into a 15 mL conical tube, rinse flask with 5–8 mL PBS and add to suspension. Centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min at RT, resuspend pellet in 1 mL GMP SCCM to a single‑cell suspension. Mix 10 mL cell suspension with 10 mL 0.4 % Trypan blue for counting; calculate total yield. Seed 2,000 cells per fibronectin‑coated TCF75 (P1) with 10–12 mL GMP SCCM, rock gently, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Refresh medium every 2–3 days and monitor confluence.

steps.title: Cryopreserve P1 cell aliquots
steps.instruction: After P1 expansion, centrifuge cell suspension 250 × g for 5 min at RT. Prepare six labeled 1.8 mL cryovials per batch. Mix CryoStor CS10 with GMP SCCM 1:1 (v/v) to obtain CS5. Add 3 mL cryopreservation medium to the cell pellet, aliquot 0.5 mL per cryovial. Freeze vials in a controlled‑rate freezing container at –80 °C (overnight to 24 h), then transfer to liquid N₂ storage (gas phase).

steps.title: Thaw and recover cryopreserved CSSCs
steps.instruction: For each cryovial, prepare a 15 mL conical tube with 9 mL GMP SCCM. Remove vial from liquid N₂, thaw in a 37 °C water bath until a tiny ice clump remains. Add 1 mL GMP medium to the vial, mix, and transfer the 10 mL suspension to the prepared tube. Mix, centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min at RT, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 1 mL GMP SCCM per TCF75 (~2,000 cells). Add 10–12 mL GMP SCCM to each fibronectin‑coated TCF75, rock gently, and place in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator. Change medium every other day and monitor colony formation.
